notes: infobae.com is Arc publishing: robots.txt (only Disallow is /buscador) lists /arc/outboundfeeds/sitemap2/, and the per-DAY file .../sitemap2/{YYYY}-{MM}-{DD}/?outputType=xml returns that whole day's output in one shot (337-1886 locs on 8 dates 09-25..10-25, every lastmod equals the day, all paths are /<section...>/YYYY/MM/DD/<slug>/; no pagination, ?from/size ignored, plain /arc/outboundfeeds/sitemap/ and the URL without outputType give the identical file). Sample articles are free, server-rendered, 4.5-5.2k chars of text.
